# Independent standard accent holdout

Original manually authored OOXML generated by
`tools/theme_standard_accents_fixture.py` through the shared original table
generator. It imports no renderer conversion and embeds no font program or
corpus content. Eight green/orange source colors (two standard accents and six
one-byte neighbors), nine modifier bytes, and both shade/tint give 144 cases.
Text, fill, and border columns use an intentionally incorrect RGB fallback.

The source was generated after the integer conversion was implemented, before
capturing its expected colors. The reference application opened it using the reference-application opener.
On 2026-10-04, native Save As PDF at Standard quality produced the same-named
PDF, renamed locally to `native.pdf`. Only the owned saved source was closed.
Its before/after SHA-256 is unchanged:
`193a4d0de105873be890eafaa9ad25d9cc472fdad270a5636e970e4e15021ab4`.

PDFium text extraction records all 144 native labels in `reference.json`,
binding source/case/PDF hashes. The native PDF has five pages, including a final
empty paragraph page after four full table pages. `tools/check-theme-color-contexts.py`
independently confirms matching native text, fill, and border colors for every
row. No saved reference DOCX was captured.

Green `9BBB59`, tint byte `99`, is C014: native RGB `(194,214,155)` / `C2D69B`.
It confirms the older paragraph/cell shading and paragraph-border tests used
rounded-HSL expectations (`C3D69B`) rather than the native result. Explicit RGB
colors remain explicit; only theme-resolved expectations change.

```text
python tools/theme_standard_accents_fixture.py --output-dir YOUR_TEMP_DIRECTORY
python tools/record_theme_boundary_colors.py tests/fixtures/theme-standard-accents --source theme-standard-accents-20261004.docx
node tools/check-theme-color-boundaries.mjs tests/fixtures/theme-standard-accents theme-standard-accents-20261004.docx
```

This is color evidence, not full layout certification. The separate 35-versus-36
row-fit difference was fixed by the shared-border page-fit change. Both the
native reference and the viewer place
36 rows on each of four table pages, followed by the blank fifth page. The
native page assignments remain covered by `tests/exact-row-page-fit-native.test.js`.
